per_mod_timeout_secs._comment: Per-mod timeout override (seconds). Falls back to config.timeout_secs (default 7200 = 2h) when a mod isn't listed. Known-slow mods that legitimately exceed the 2h global cap get a bump here. dw_talents HLAs (cn:60200) scans the full override/ dir — on a 120k-file megainstall each slow cn can run 1-3h.

force_single_cn_mods._comment: Components that must run as single-component batches so a timeout on the slow cn doesn't drag its batch-mates into AUTO_SKIP. dw_talents 60200 = Revised HLAs, 60300 = Leveller.

eet_auto_fill_trigger: Enter the full path to your BG:EE+SoD installation

readln_defaults._comment: Auto-answer READLN prompts per mod. Each entry is a list of responses sent in order.

sibling_directories._comment: When mod X is junctioned, also junction sibling directory Y from the same parent. Key = mod folder name (lowercase), Value = list of sibling folder names.

_enable_biff_delete_optimization_doc: A/B harness toggle for the mid-install BIFF-delete optimization. When a boolean is set (true or false), overrides the UI's user-facing setting for BOTH start_native_install and start_dry_run paths. When absent (the default), the UI value (default: true) applies. The orchestrator emits a `[PREBIFF] delete_optimization=<bool> reason=<ran|biff_missing|disabled> biffed=N deleted=N delete_errors=N override_before=N override_after=N biff_file_size=N` line to install.log on every run that reaches the BIFF step — analyze_install_log.py in weidu_experimental/tools/ parses this to confirm which variant executed. Uncomment `enable_biff_delete_optimization` below to pin:

_enable_biff_delete_optimization_example.baseline_A: enable_biff_delete_optimization: false  — MAKE_BIFF runs but override/ stays full (pre-fix behaviour; expect 4h+ on dw_talents cn:60200)
_enable_biff_delete_optimization_example.biff_only_C: enable_biff_delete_optimization: true  — with cache off, isolates the BIFF-delete win
_enable_biff_delete_optimization_example.combined_D: enable_biff_delete_optimization: true  — with cache on, full stack
